thread:
Omar: Hey all, quick onboarding snag. I clicked the org invite but GitHub shows me as 'Member (limited)'. I can't open private repo 'sdk-examples'. Anyone seen this status before?

Tess (People Ops): @Omar welcome! Limited usually means SSO not applied. Did you complete the SAML sign-in after accepting the invite?

Omar: I followed the invite link, it redirected to our idp and I signed in, but the org page still shows 'Member (limited)'. 2FA is on.

Kai (EngAdmin): Hi @Omar 010 - sometimes the org needs a manual sync. Can you paste the exact invite email username (the GitHub handle) and run `gh auth status`?

Omar: handle is omar-j. gh auth status: Logged in to github.com as omar-j (OAuth).

access-bot: [system] Created ticket #303: "SSO sync required for omar-j".

Kai (EngAdmin): Thanks. I've triggered a directory sync and re-applied SSO mapping. Try refreshing and cloning: `git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/sdk-examples.git`

Omar: cloning failed with permission denied. After a refresh the org shows full 'Member' now though.

Kai (EngAdmin): Run `ssh -T git@github.com` to confirm identity. If it still fails, re-add your SSH key under the account that shows as member.

Omar: `ssh -T` returned "Hi omar-j! You've successfully authenticated..." Clone worked after re-trying. All good now, thanks.

Tess (People Ops): Welcome aboard Omar! If anyone else hits 'Member (limited)' file a ticket and ping EngAdmin. :tada:
